title: The launch come-back email brings a signed-out member back to their own launch

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: The come-back email's one button links the bare /launch (lib/launch/comeback-email.ts). A member whose session has expired is hopped by proxy.ts (CREATE_SPACE_DOORS) to the anonymous Create a Space wizard and sees an empty builder instead of their launch. /launch/resume, which its own comment says the emails carry, is linked from nowhere, and on a signed-out request it redirects to /sign-in with no next, so even if linked it would drop them on the feed after signing in. Fix: link a route that sends a signed-out visitor to /sign-in?next=/launch (keeping lid), and have /launch/resume carry next.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
